headline.purpose: Major section headings and CTA headlines.

body.purpose: Readable product explanation and dense supporting copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, buttons, tabs, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: active-dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Timeline emphasis and active state marks.

motion.name: ascii-wave-drift
motion.purpose: Slow atmospheric ASCII movement behind the landing page.

motion.name: ascii-glow-pulse
motion.purpose: Soft foreground glow for the trace imagery.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Required alternative for decorative ASCII motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast CTA for trial and approval actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.58); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f1f1f1, #c6c6c6); color: #1c1c1c; font: 800 13px/1 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fb6e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action for demo or secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(241,241,241,0.25); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(241,241,241,0.03); color: #f1f1f1; font: 800 13px/1 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fb6e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.html:
Trace & inspect

Inspect traces, inputs, and results to understand every decision.
components.css: .ds-panel-card { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(241,241,241,0.14); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(241,241,241,0.06), rgba(241,241,241,0.025)), rgba(28,28,28,0.78); color: #f1f1f1; box-shadow: 0 28px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.42); font-family: Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 18px/1.2 'Roboto Slab', Georgia, serif; } .ds-panel-card p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: rgba(241,241,241,0.68); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Approval Pill
components.description: Small status mark for pending approvals.
components.css: .ds-approval-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(241,241,241,0.14); border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(241,241,241,0.68); background: rgba(241,241,241,0.035); font: 700 11px/1 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mock Address Field
components.description: Read-only browser address field inside product previews.
components.css: .ds-mock-address { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(241,241,241,0.14); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(28,28,28,0.7); color: rgba(241,241,241,0.44); font: 400 11px/1.4 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Compact top navigation for the landing page.
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 34px; color: #f1f1f1; font: 700 13px/1 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary-nav a:hover, .ds-primary-nav a:focus-visible { color: #ffffff; outline: none; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
CodePawl's interface should feel like a controlled operating room for computer agents: dark, legible, instrumented, and calm under pressure. The visual system uses a charcoal monochrome shell, restrained semantic accents, compact panels, and visible traces of agent work through ASCII motion and product-preview artifacts.

The brand is premium because it is precise, not because it is decorative. The page should show runtime mechanics, approval gates, live browser surfaces, usage metrics, and replayable traces as proof that the product keeps powerful agents bounded.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal monochrome foundation with rare semantic color.
8px compact geometry across buttons, cards, previews, and panels.
Lato body text paired with Roboto Slab display and section headings.
Atmospheric ASCII/trace motion that never hides content.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors must explain state or risk. Do not use the status palette as decoration.

rules.name: The Monochrome Confidence Rule
rules.body: Most surfaces stay charcoal and white; color appears because the operator needs to understand a run.

rules.name: The No Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code snippets, telemetry, and ASCII atmosphere only; it is not the default way to say "technical."

rules.name: The Slab Restraint Rule
rules.body: Roboto Slab carries brand voice in headings and labels. Do not introduce a second display family unless the identity is deliberately refreshed.

rules.name: The One Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use the large shadow for meaningful surface separation only. Small nested items rely on borders and tonal fills.

dos: Do keep CodePawl dark, calm, and legible with #1c1c1c as the dominant surface.
Do use semantic accents only for success, risk, info, and destructive states.
Do keep card and panel radius at 8px unless a pill status label is required.
Do show approvals, traces, cost, and current run state as product proof.
Do preserve reduced-motion support for ASCII and trace motion.
Do keep body text contrast strong; muted copy should remain readable on dark and translucent surfaces.
donts: Don't make CodePawl look like a neon cyberpunk agent dashboard.
Don't build an overloaded observability wall full of charts before the user understands the run.
Don't make the product feel like a raw terminal-first tool.
Don't promise effortless full autonomy, enterprise RPA replacement, CAPTCHA bypassing, or safety without human approval.
Don't use accent color as decoration.
Don't pair wide decorative shadows with every bordered nested item.
Don't introduce repeated tiny uppercase section eyebrows as a default scaffold.
